usedFor: Calendly records the meetings and Dropbox stores the files that belong with them. “When a meeting recap is created” in Calendly can run “Upload File to Dropbox”, saving a document once the call is over.

bestTemplate.name: “When a meeting recap is created” in Calendly, then “Upload File to Dropbox”
bestTemplate.why: A recap is created after the meeting, when notes or deliverables are ready to file, and the action lets you choose whether an existing file is added, replaced or updated.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” saves a file from a public web link, so the trigger has to supply one. “When a contact is deleted” also reaches it, which is rarely what you want.
